facts.fact: Daily News Egypt reports NARSS and the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation presented a crop map for the 2023-24 winter season, with each governorate using remote sensing data to inventory and classify wheat, clover and sugar beet.

systems.owner: NARSS with Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

EGY.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
The AI use is crop classification, a sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: Daily News Egypt reports NARSS, with the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, used remote sensing and artificial intelligence to inventory and classify crops by governorate, producing a 2023-24 winter crop map presented in November 2024.

systems.owner: NARSS with Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

EGY.note: Document does not say an AI model was built or released in the country.
